name: cbio-difg-glass
description: Whole genome or whole exome sequencing analysis of temporally separated diffuse glioma tumor/normal pairs from 329 adult patients. The data provided is based on the May 31, 2022 version and can be accessed at Synapse.

recordSet.name: Clinical variables with measured completeness
recordSet.description: Completeness is measured from the source repository's own records. A field populated entirely with non-answers is reported as populated but not informative, because it blocks an analysis just as surely as an absent field.

field.name: Oncotree Code
field.description: Category: diagnosis. Populated for 100.0% of cases; informative (excluding non-answers) for 100.0%.

field.name: Overall Survival
field.description: Category: outcome. Populated for 95.4% of cases; informative (excluding non-answers) for 95.4%.

field.name: Sex
field.description: Category: demographic. Populated for 95.4% of cases; informative (excluding non-answers) for 95.4%.

field.name: Tumor Grade

field.name: Overall Survival (months)
field.description: Category: followup. Populated for 95.1% of cases; one-to-many field, per-case shares not derivable.
